args.title: slugify() strips any character outside [a-z0-9] after NFKD normalization
args.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() strips any character outside [a-z0-9] after NFKD normalization, so non-Latin scripts (Greek, Cyrillic) are removed entirely, leaving only the "report" fallback used by formatExportFilename in exportUtils.ts. It should preserve letters from scripts that NFKD doesn't decompose into combining accents (e.g. allow \p{L}/\p{N} unicode categories) instead of restricting to ASCII a-z0-9, so names like Greek/Bulgarian report titles keep their original letters in exported file names.

file: src/util/strings.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
src/util/strings.ts slugify() does value.normalize("NFKD").replace(accent marks).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-") which removes all non-ASCII letters; src/exportUtils.ts line 60 uses `const base = slugify(reportName) || "report";` so a Greek/Cyrillic-only name becomes empty and falls back to the generic "report" name, matching the reported symptom.
